//: Catalogue of my OrcaSlicer plugins. Install-Orca-Plugins.bat downloads THIS file and nothing else it hasn't learned from here, so adding a new plugin = adding an entry below. A .bat already sitting on a laptop picks it up on its next run with no edit.

plugins.name: Support Fins
plugins.summary: Adds printfins.com breakaway support fins under overhangs at slice time.

plugins.name: Wave Overhangs
plugins.summary: Prints steep overhangs support-free with wave-propagated toolpaths. Check Preview before printing.

plugins.name: Unlayered Infill
plugins.summary: Non-planar sparse infill: rides a sine wave in Z so layers interlock, tapering flat at the solid skin. No dependencies. Check Preview before printing.
